title: Shortcut table re-pointed across 226 entries
summary: Nothing visible to a player changed in this version's palmons, skills, items, systems, text or art. The only data change is the internal goto table, the where-do-I-get-this shortcuts: 226 entries are re-pointed to different descriptions, icons and destinations, and three are removed.
highlights: 226 goto shortcut entries change their description, icon or jump target, for example Dojo Challenge, VIP Shop, Black Friday Madness and Mariner's Hoard.
Three goto entries are removed: Desert Mastery, Daily Quests and Purchase Bundles.
